calls.head: Different speeds
calls.body: Anaheim ranks 2nd of 32 for pace, toward the fast end; Florida ranks 26th, toward the slow end.

calls.head: Different shooting spots
calls.body: On point-shot reliance, Anaheim sits 8th of 32, at the point-heavy end of the scale. Florida is 31st, at the down low end.

surprises.head: Anaheim won without the better chances
surprises.body: Expected goals favoured Florida, 3.5 to 2.4, with empty nets left out. L. Dostal stopped 1.5 more goals than expected.

surprises.head: Anaheim shot far less than usual
surprises.body: 39.7 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5, adjusted for score and venue, against its usual 59.8.

surprises.head: Anaheim tried a different line
surprises.body: N. Nesterenko, R. Poehling, S. Colangelo played 7:30 together at 5-on-5, a trio that isn’t one of Anaheim’s usual lines.
